cocaine.overview: Gather the requirements, head to one of the coke islands, pick coca leaves, then process them into Fresh Cocaine Bricks and take them to the lab.
cocaine.requirements:
Coca Leaves (picked on the islands)
Cement (8 bags per 200 leaves)
Gasoline (1 per 10 Coca Blend)
Hydrochloric Acid (1 per 2 Coca Paste)
Empty bags (take them to the lab with the bricks)
cocaine.locations:
Island 1: Above Cayo Perico.
Island 2 (hidden): In line with the mining area, a few hundred metres out to sea.
Island 3: Top right of the map.
Island 4: Left side of the map, in line with Zancudo.
Coke lab: Postal 720.
cocaine.steps:
Gather coca leaves.
Gather Gasoline and Hydrochloric Acid.
Head to an island with the Gasoline, Hydrochloric Acid and leaves.
Go to the pit and put in 200 leaves (50 at a time) and 8 Cement (2 at a time).
Run around the pit (use /walk quick) collecting all the paste until you are out of leaves and Cement.
Put the Coca Blend and Gasoline into the barrels, 10 Coca Blend per 1 Gasoline.
Put the Coca Paste and Hydrochloric Acid into the cooking wok, 2 Paste per 1 Hydrochloric Acid.
Take the Fresh Cocaine Bricks and empty bags to the coke lab at postal 720.
cocaine.tips:
Use 8 bags of Cement per 200 leaves in the mixer.
Use 1 Gasoline per 10 Coca Blend.
Use 1 Hydrochloric Acid per 2 Paste.
The coke lab is owned by La Raza. They don't care about the islands, but they tax or rob at the lab.
If you are avoiding the tax, have someone watch the lab from a distance so you are ready.
You can carry someone while stomping the coca leaves and Cement. It speeds things up because two people are technically doing it, which is handy if someone is in head.
